title.zh_CN: 折戟之夜：远望风控重组计划

text.zh_CN: （交易大厅的顶灯已经熄了一大半，林岚拉过一把椅子坐在你的工位旁）别盯着那条深水区净值曲线发呆了。十年前我第一次独立管盘时，也曾在流动性枯竭的夜里看着净值跌去四成。
text.en: (Half the ceiling lights on the floor are already dark; Lin Lan pulls a chair beside your desk) Stop staring at that underwater equity curve. Ten years ago on my first solo book, I watched 40% evaporate in a single liquidity freeze too.

text.zh_CN: 你的账户净值已经跌破远望二级风控红线（$58,000）。高倍融资、逆势扛单或是遭遇逼空，只要经历过一次刻骨铭心的痛，比背诵一百遍教科书都管用。学院不想让你因为一次重创就删档从零开始——我们启动了《远望风控重组保护机制》。
text.en: Your account equity has breached Farview's Tier-2 risk floor ($58,000). Over-leveraging, fighting the tape, or getting caught in a short squeeze teaches more in one scar than a hundred textbooks. You shouldn't have to wipe your save over one blow-up — we're activating the Farview Risk Restructuring Protocol.

speaker.zh_CN: 老陈 · 交易大厅前辈

text.zh_CN: 华尔街活下来的老家伙，谁身上没两道疤？摔倒不可怕，带着教训爬起来把本金一点点挣回来，那才叫真本事。
text.en: Show me an old-timer on Wall Street without a scar or two. Getting knocked down isn't fatal — getting back up with strict stops and grinding your book back is what makes a trader.

text.zh_CN: 面对账户重创后的《远望风控重组方案》，你的决定是：
text.en: Facing the Farview Risk Restructuring offer after a severe drawdown, what do you choose?

text.zh_CN: 签署风控军令状，接受远望重组备用金注资（+$35,000 实盘现金），重整旗鼓！
text.en: Sign the risk covenant & accept Farview's restructuring injection (+$35,000 cash) to rebuild!

toast.zh_CN: 风控重组完成：+$35,000 重整备用金已注入实盘账户！

text.zh_CN: 婉拒大额输血，仅领 $5,000 应急保证金缓冲，凭剩余本金极限翻盘！
text.en: Decline full bailout; take only a $5,000 margin buffer and claw back the hard way!

toast.zh_CN: 硬核自救：立下【绝地翻盘】誓言（+$5,000 应急缓冲）！
toast.en: Iron-grit path: Vowed a pure comeback (+$5,000 margin buffer)!

text.zh_CN: 重整资金已经划入你的现金账户。记住今晚签下的规矩：建仓先设止损，单票绝不赌身家。去把失去的阵地一寸一寸赢回来吧。
text.en: Restructuring funds have hit your cash balance. Remember the covenant you signed tonight: set stops before entry, and never bet the farm on a single ticker. Now go earn your ground back.

text.zh_CN: 有骨气。既然选了最难的绝地反击路，就更要珍惜手里的每一颗子弹。等你重新站回 $100,000 水位线的那天，整座远望大厅都会为你鼓掌。
text.en: Spoken with backbone. Walking the steepest comeback road means every bullet counts. The day you climb back above the $100,000 watermark, the entire Farview floor will applaud.
